subject: Blank output until action button is pressed

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Blank output until action button is pressed
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am new to shiny, love it and starting to learn.

One quick question, related to the action button widget (https://gallery.shinyapps.io/028-actionbutton-demo/): 
I noticed that mainPanel() is updated from the very start, would it be possible to have it populated only if (and after) the action button is pressed?

Thanks,
Adrian

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Blank output until action button is pressed
parts:
Yes, in server.R you'd replace:

    input$goButton

with either:

    validate(need(input$goButton, FALSE))

or more intuitively:

    if (input$goButton == 0) return()

messages.subject: Re: Blank output until action button is pressed
parts:
Hi again,
(and happy new year to everyone)

I found that using this solution still triggers the output:
- once the action button was pressed once
- after that, at each change of any of the inputs

Managed to solve that by using isolate() on all the other inputs, which is fine... but now I have a rather different problem.

What I', trying to achieve is to:
- upload a data set (using example from http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/file-upload.html)
- populate a selectBox with the names of the variables, using updateSelectInput()
- do something in the output based on the selected variables

Placing updateSelectInput() inside isolate() seems to solve it, but it doesn't trigger the change until the action button is pressed.

What I am now aiming for is to:
- upload a file
- populate the select box with the variables inside the uploaded data
- do something in the output (again) if and only after the action button is pressed, function of some variables which are selected.

This is probably a bit more complicated, but hopefully clear. Should I submit a demo code or something?

Thanks very much again,
Adrian
